summary: A resident on {street} can see the pipe crew's patch from the kitchen window and the old pavement on either side.
realLife: Oakland required a utility to restore a lane over its excavation and could pay the difference to carry the new surface across the street.
gates: The city manages the affected street and has the project facts described here.
inGame: The city highways budget records the appropriation change. needs: excavation permit, required patch width and city's share of the full-width price.

turns.pulledBy: The city increases its street appropriation and the following records identify an eligible use: excavation permit, required patch width and city's share of the full-width price.
turns.what: Offer to cover the remainder while the utility has a crew there.
turns.writesBack: Permit restoration limits and city reimbursement.

turns.pulledBy: A smaller city appropriation requires the office to revisit the commitment documented by these records: excavation permit, required patch width and city's share of the full-width price.
turns.what: Give residents the limits of the utility patch and remove the unfunded city share from the work order.
turns.writesBack: Permit restoration limits and city reimbursement.
